name: Projection lag
questionAnswered: How many seconds elapsed between the newest committed authoritative state represented and generation of this rebuildable dashboard projection?

calculation.formula: projection generated time minus newest represented authoritative commit time
calculation.rounding: Round down only after computing the exact nonnegative duration; this fixture uses whole-second timestamps.

scopeSemantics.qualification: Lag measures projection currency relative to represented committed state, not the age of the underlying source observation.

interpretation.doesMean: The dashboard projection was generated the stated duration after the newest authoritative commit it represents.
doesNotMean: The source evidence itself is fresh.
Every authoritative record has been projected.
A low-lag dashboard is complete or accurate.
The dashboard is the system of record.
interpretation.whenUnavailable: Show unavailable when either timestamp is absent or the generated time precedes the represented commit time.
